user.title: Connect to the D-LOGG
user.description: Enter the serial port of the D-LOGG USB adapter (e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM4).

channels.title: Configure channels
channels.description: All channels are listed in schematic order (C1_S1..C1_S16, C1_A1..C1_A16, C2_...). Every channel is disabled by default - give it a name and a type to enable it: Temperature, Power or Switch (read-only).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the D-LOGG. Check the port and that the device is plugged in.
error.no_channels: No usable channels were detected on the D-LOGG.

init.title: D-LOGG options
init.description: Change the polling interval and rename or retype the channels.
